title: 'It's Showtime' host Cianne Dominguez’s car hit in motorcycle hit-and-run

blocks.text: Cianne Dominguez, one of the hosts of the noontime program “It’s Showtime,” took to social media to find the motorcycle rider who hit her car and fled while she was driving in Antipolo. Dominguez shared clips of the incident captured by the dash cam installed in her car, through her Facebook page on Monday, Oct. 5. In the video, Dominguez’s vehicle slowed down to let a tricycle cross when a motorcycle carrying a rider and one passenger hit her car from behind and fled the scene. “‘Di ko alam talaga bakit ako lapitin ng mga kamote sa daan talaga.
